startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Category URL(s) to start scraping from. In MVP, use exactly one category URL (e.g., https://www.designrush.com/agency/web-development-companies)

maxItems.title: Max Items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of company profiles to process. Set to 0 for unlimited.

startPage.title: Start Page
startPage.description: Page number to start scraping from (1-based). Use this to skip already scraped pages or resume from a specific page.

maxPages.title: Max Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to process (0 = unlimited). The scraper will stop after processing this many pages.

requiredFields.title: Required Fields
requiredFields.description: Only push leads that have ALL selected fields filled. Leave empty to push all leads.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy configuration for anti-bot protection. Recommended to use Apify Proxy for best results.
